content_review.notes: Each English and Chinese section was compared line by line. Exact species identity, accepted-name conflicts, IUCN mapping, numeric claims, distribution geometry and photo look-alike risks were checked against the cited sources. Display polygons are conservative generalizations and never imply continuous occupancy.

conservation_status.note_en: The current species-level global category checked on 2026-09-11 is Least Concern; regional and legal categories may differ.
conservation_status.note_zh: 已于2026-09-11核对当前物种级全球等级为无危；地区等级和法律地位可能不同。

description.en: The Satanic Leaf-tailed Gecko is a small nocturnal gecko found only in Madagascar. Its flattened, ragged-edged tail, mottled body and pointed scales recreate the shape and texture of a dead leaf with extraordinary precision.
description.zh: 撒旦叶尾壁虎是仅见于马达加斯加的小型夜行壁虎。扁平且边缘破损状的尾、斑驳身体和尖突鳞片，极其精确地重现枯叶的形状与质感。

anatomy.en: Usually about 9 cm long, it may be mottled brown, gray or rust. The tail can show vein-like ridges and missing-looking notches, while large eyes have vertical pupils and pointed scales above them resemble small horns.
anatomy.zh: 通常全长约9厘米，颜色可呈斑驳的棕、灰或锈红。尾部可见叶脉状棱和仿佛缺损的凹口；大眼具有纵向瞳孔，眼上尖鳞像小角。

ecology_and_behavior.en: It sleeps among low branches and shrubs by day and becomes active at night. Wild diet remains incompletely known; captive animals take small invertebrates such as crickets and moths. Individuals generally remain below about 3 m.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 白天它在低矮枝条和灌木间休息，夜间活动。野外食谱尚不完整；圈养个体会捕食蟋蟀、蛾等小型无脊椎动物。通常活动高度不超过约3米。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Endemic to humid forests of eastern, southeastern and southern Madagascar. It lives in trees and bushes, usually close to the forest floor; the displayed belt is a conservative regional generalization, not continuous occupancy.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 特有于马达加斯加东部、东南部和南部的湿润森林，生活在树木和灌木上，通常接近林地表层。地图带状范围是保守地区概化，并不表示处处连续分布。

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: It is oviparous. Females place clutches of two spherical eggs in leaf litter around the start of Madagascar's rainy season, approximately month 11 (November). Reported lifespan reaches about 15 years in human care; wild longevity is unknown.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 它为卵生。雌性约在马达加斯加雨季开始的11月，把每窝两枚球形卵产于落叶层中。圈养寿命记录可达约15年，野外寿命未知。

detail.en: Flattening, vein-like ridges and irregular notches reproduce damaged leaf edges.
detail.zh: 扁平形态、叶脉状棱和不规则缺口模仿受损叶缘。

detail.en: Brown, gray and rust color forms match different dead leaves and bark.
detail.zh: 棕、灰和锈红等色型可匹配不同枯叶与树皮。

detail.en: When camouflage fails it can open a bright red mouth and cry at approaching predators.
detail.zh: 伪装失效时，它会张开鲜红口腔并发声威吓靠近的捕食者。

ecological_role.en: As a small nocturnal invertebrate predator, it transfers energy from forest-floor and shrub arthropods to snakes, birds and other predators. Its dependence on intact humid understory ties it to forest condition.
ecological_role.zh: 作为小型夜行无脊椎动物捕食者，它把林地表层和灌丛节肢动物的能量传递给蛇、鸟等捕食者；对完整湿润林下层的依赖使其与森林状况紧密相连。

threats.en: Currently assessed as Least Concern, but its future depends on eastern Madagascar rainforest remaining intact. Habitat loss and illegal or poorly controlled pet collection are continuing management concerns; population trend is uncertain.
threats.zh: 目前评估为无危，但其未来取决于马达加斯加东部雨林能否保持完整。生境丧失以及非法或管理不善的宠物采集仍是持续问题；种群趋势不确定。

actions.en: Protect humid forest and understory, enforce wildlife-trade rules, verify legal captive origin and never release captive geckos. Monitoring should retain exact locality while protecting sensitive collection sites.
actions.zh: 应保护湿润森林及林下层，执行野生动物贸易法规，核实圈养来源合法性，且绝不放生圈养壁虎。监测需保留精确地点，同时保护敏感采集地。

key_features.en: Small leaf-tailed gecko with a broad leaf-shaped tail, apparent bite-like edge notches, horn-like scales above the eyes and mottled dead-leaf coloration.
key_features.zh: 小型叶尾壁虎，尾宽而像叶片，边缘有仿佛虫咬的缺口，眼上有角状尖鳞，整体呈枯叶般斑驳色。

similar_species.en: Uroplatus ebenaui has a shorter, less leaf-like tail and closely overlaps in appearance. Species-level photos should show the characteristic broad ragged leaf tail or carry expert identification and locality metadata.
similar_species.zh: 埃本氏叶尾壁虎的尾更短、叶状程度较弱，外形却高度相近。物种级照片应清楚显示宽而破叶状的特征尾，或具有专家鉴定和地点元数据。

communication_and_senses.en: Large eyes with vertical pupils suit dim forest light. Communication is poorly known; a wide red-mouth display and loud cry are used when threatened.
communication_and_senses.zh: 大眼和纵瞳适应昏暗森林光线。交流方式了解很少；受威胁时会张开红色口腔并大声叫喊。

seasonal_calendar.en: Egg laying begins around the start of the rainy season in month 11 (November). Otherwise, a detailed wild annual cycle is not established.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 产卵约在11月雨季开始时启动。除此之外，野外年度节律尚未被完整建立。

relationship_with_humans.en: The dramatic name reflects appearance, not dangerous behavior. It is sensitive to handling and habitat conditions, so responsible interest should favor observation and verified captive-bred animals rather than wild collection.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 其夸张俗名来自外形，并不代表危险行为。它对抓握和环境条件敏感，负责任的兴趣应以观察和来源可核实的人工繁育个体为主，而非野捕。

evolution.en: Satanic Leaf-tailed Gecko is placed in genus Uroplatus, family Gekkonidae, order Squamata. This record follows the species-level binomial Uroplatus phantasticus; documented accepted-name conflicts are stated explicitly, and no claims or images are transferred from look-alike species.
evolution.zh: 撒旦叶尾壁虎归入叶尾壁虎属、壁虎科、有鳞目。本条目采用物种级二名法Uroplatus phantasticus；已知接受名冲突会明确说明，且不会从外形相近物种移用说法或图片。

field_signs.en: By day, inspect low dead leaves and thin branches for a still silhouette whose tail completes the leaf illusion. At night use minimal light, avoid touching vegetation around a detected animal and record the tail edge for identification.
field_signs.zh: 白天可在低处枯叶和细枝间寻找静止轮廓，尾巴会补全枯叶幻象。夜间应尽量少用灯，不触碰个体周围植被，并记录尾缘以供鉴定。

text.en: Its tail can mimic leaf veins, decay and missing pieces.
text.zh: 它的尾能同时模仿叶脉、腐坏和残缺。

text.en: It usually stays within roughly 3 m of the forest floor.
text.zh: 它通常不会离森林地面超过约3米。

text.en: The accepted record has no recognized subspecies in the Reptile Database.
text.zh: 爬行动物数据库中的接受记录没有承认亚种。

content.en: Adhesive toes keep the gecko secure on low vegetation while a flattened body and tail erase the usual lizard outline. Remaining motionless is as important as coloration.
content.zh: 黏附趾使它稳固停在低矮植被上，扁平身体和尾则抹去常见蜥蜴轮廓；保持不动与颜色同样重要。

habitat.text_en: Endemic to humid forests of eastern, southeastern and southern Madagascar. It lives in trees and bushes, usually close to the forest floor; the displayed belt is a conservative regional generalization, not continuous occupancy.
habitat.text_zh: 特有于马达加斯加东部、东南部和南部的湿润森林，生活在树木和灌木上，通常接近林地表层。地图带状范围是保守地区概化，并不表示处处连续分布。

range_review.comparison_en: This new record has no previous geometry. The displayed nonrectangular polygons conservatively generalize the cited institutional or peer-reviewed distribution evidence for readable world-map display. Boundaries are approximate and never imply continuous occupancy within every enclosed area.
range_review.comparison_zh: 这是没有旧几何的新记录。显示的非矩形多边形依据所引机构或同行评审分布证据作保守概化，以便世界地图清晰呈现。边界为近似范围，绝不表示圈内每处都有连续分布。
